chunks: My father (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn al-Hasan al-Mu'addab narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Ali al-Isfahani, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who said: Muhammad ibn Ali narrated to us, saying: Ibn Harasa al-Shaybani narrated to us, saying: Ja'far ibn Ziyad al-Ahmar narrated to us from Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them),
that he recited: "And their father had been a righteous man, so your Lord intended them to reach maturity and extract their treasure" [18:82].

Then Zayd said: Allah protected them because of the righteousness of their father. So who is more deserving of good protection than us?! The Messenger of Allah is our grandfather, his daughter is our mother, the Mistress of his Women is our grandmother, and the first to believe in him and pray with him is our father.

key_terms.أولى: More deserving/more entitled -- a comparative form asserting the Ahl al-Bayt's superior claim
key_terms.حفظ: Protection/preservation -- divine safeguarding of the righteous and their offspring
key_terms.صالحا: Righteous -- the Quranic description of the father whose righteousness protected his orphaned children

ai.seo_question: What did Zayd ibn Ali say about Quran 18:82 and the protection of the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: Zayd ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn (d. 122 AH), the great-grandson of Imam Ali, cited Quran 18:82 -- the story of Khidr protecting the orphans' treasure because of their righteous father -- to argue that the Ahl al-Bayt are even more deserving of divine protection. He enumerated the family's credentials: the Prophet Muhammad is their grandfather, Fatimah al-Zahra their mother, Khadijah their grandmother, and Imam Ali -- the first man to believe and pray with the Prophet -- their father. This hadith was narrated in an assembly held on Tuesday, the 10th of Sha'ban, 368 AH.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. al-Hasan al-Mu’addab narrated to us from Ahmad b. `Ali al-Isfahani from Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Muhammad b. `Ali narrated to us. He said: Ibn Harasa al-Shaybani narrated to us. He said: Ja`far b. Ziyad al-Ahmar narrated to us from Zayd b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. `Ali (as).
He recited, “Their father had been a righteous man, so your Lord intended them to reach maturity and then extract their treasure.” [18:82]

Then, Zayd said: Allah protected them because of the righteousness of their father; so, who is more deserving of protection than us?! The Messenger of Allah is our grandfather, his daughter is our mother, the Mistress of his Women is our grandmother, and the first to believe in him and pray with him is our father.
